description: Global grading rules for FSI drill accepted_outputs matching. These rules apply to ALL drill items unless an item-level override exists.

discourse_marker_comma_optional.description: When accepted_output begins with 'Sí, ' or 'No, ', the comma is optional for matching purposes. In spoken audio, commas are inaudible. The grader should normalize both 'Sí, X' and 'Sí X' to the same canonical form before comparison.
discourse_marker_comma_optional.applies_to: all items where accepted_outputs starts with 'Sí,' or 'No,'
discourse_marker_comma_optional.note: The discourse marker word itself (Sí/No) remains REQUIRED when the prompt explicitly asks for an affirmative/negative response. Only the trailing comma is optional.

accent_normalization.description: When require_accents is true, all orthographic accents must be present. Modern RAE 2010 rules apply: demonstrative pronouns (este, ese, aquel) are NEVER accented. The adverb 'solo' is NEVER accented.
accent_normalization.rae_2010_demonstratives: este/ese/aquel as pronouns: no accent (éste → este)
accent_normalization.rae_2010_solo: solo as adverb: no accent (sólo → solo)

clitic_placement_with_periphrastic.description: For periphrastic constructions (ir + a + infinitive, tener + que + infinitive, etc.), both clitic positions are valid: proclitic on conjugated verb ('lo voy a llevar') and enclitic on infinitive ('voy a llevarlo'). Items should include both forms in accepted_outputs where applicable.
clitic_placement_with_periphrastic.note: This has been applied to identified items. If new periphrastic items are added, ensure both forms are listed.

locative_adverb_equivalence.description: Whisper cannot reliably distinguish 'ahí' [aˈi] from 'allí' [aˈʝi]. In Colombian Spanish these are used interchangeably in most contexts. Before comparison, the grader should normalize both to a single canonical form (e.g. 'ahí').
locative_adverb_equivalence.note: None of the current drills test the spatial distinction between ahí/allí. The tested grammar point is always something else (conjugation, possessives, etc.).

stt_normalization.description: Before comparing STT output to accepted_outputs, the grader should: (1) normalize Unicode (NFC), (2) trim whitespace, (3) collapse multiple spaces, (4) remove trailing period if present, (5) apply discourse_marker_comma_optional rule, (6) apply locative_adverb_equivalence rule.
stt_normalization.punctuation_policy: sentence-final period is optional; all other punctuation must match
